Method of Attack: In-browser cryptocurrency mining (cryptojacking) via JavaScript code loaded from domains associated with cryptojacking services
Use of cryptojacking proxy servers to evade detection by hosting scripts on attacker-controlled domains and using custom mining pools to keep mined Monero without paying fees
Attack Vector: Loading JavaScript cryptojacking scripts in browsers from domains associated with cryptojacking services or attacker-controlled proxy servers
Indicators of Compromise: Domains associated with CoinHive and other cryptojacking services (CryptoLoot, DeepMiner)
High CPU usage in browsers indicating presence of cryptojacking scripts
